description: Create a new shipping address. The address is auto-marked as validated.

name.description: The recipient or sender name for the address.

street2.description: Optional secondary street line (apt, suite, unit).

is_residential.description: Whether the address is residential (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created address object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single address by its object_id.

object_id.description: The unique object_id of the address.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the address object; on failure (address not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a shipment between a from-address and a to-address, generating carrier rates. Addresses are given by object_id.

address_from.description: The object_id of the origin address.

address_to.description: The object_id of the destination address.

parcels.description: Optional object_id of the parcel for the shipment.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created shipment object (with generated rates); on failure (address not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single shipment by its object_id, including its addresses, parcels, and rates.

object_id.description: The unique object_id of the shipment.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the shipment object; on failure (shipment not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all carrier rates available for a shipment.

object_id.description: The unique object_id of the shipment.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with count and results (a list of rate objects); on failure (shipment not found), output contains an error message.

description: Purchase a shipping label for a given rate, producing a transaction with a tracking number.

rate.description: The object_id of the rate to purchase a label for.

async_.description: Optional flag to request asynchronous label creation (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created transaction object (label_url, tracking_number, carrier); on failure (rate not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single transaction (purchased label) by its object_id.

object_id.description: The unique object_id of the transaction.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the transaction object; on failure (transaction not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the tracking status and history for a tracking number with a specific carrier.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number to look up.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output includes carrier, tracking_number, current tracking_status, and tracking_history; on failure (tracking not found), output contains an error message.
